t_Sys_ProtocolVersion.name: Sys.ProtocolVersion
t_Sys_ProtocolVersion.label: Sys.ProtocolVersion
t_Sys_ProtocolVersion.description: Register map version (currently 4). Bridge refuses to run on a mismatch.

t_Sys_PlcHeartbeat.name: Sys.PlcHeartbeat
t_Sys_PlcHeartbeat.label: Sys.PlcHeartbeat
t_Sys_PlcHeartbeat.description: Incremented by the PLC at ≥ 1 Hz. Bridge marks the PLC offline if it stops changing for 3 s.

t_Sys_LineState.name: Sys.LineState
t_Sys_LineState.label: Sys.LineState
t_Sys_LineState.description: bit0 RUNNING, bit1 ESTOP_ACTIVE, bit2 SAFETY_OK (safety relay closed), bit3 FAULT (station fault latched, see Sys.FaultCode), bit4 HMI_LINK_OK, bit5 DIGITAL_ESTOP, bit6 PHYSICAL_ESTOP, bit7 RESET_REQUIRED, bit8 LOCAL_MODE, bit9 REMOTE_RESET_ALLOWED, bit10 SIMULATION.

t_Sys_TankEnableMask.name: Sys.TankEnableMask
t_Sys_TankEnableMask.label: Sys.TankEnableMask
t_Sys_TankEnableMask.description: bit k-1 = tank slot k enabled. HMI add/remove tank writes this. PLC refuses a mask of 0; in-flight containers that still need a disabled tank are rejected (under-filled). Queued recipes with the old tank count are held back (event 19).

t_Counts_Rejected.name: Counts.Rejected
t_Counts_Rejected.label: Counts.Rejected
t_Counts_Rejected.description: Containers rejected, incl. scan rejects and jams (wraps).

t_Perf_ThroughputCpm.name: Perf.ThroughputCpm
t_Perf_ThroughputCpm.label: Perf.ThroughputCpm
t_Perf_ThroughputCpm.description: Accepted containers per minute, rolling window.

t_Oee_Availability.name: Oee.Availability
t_Oee_Availability.label: Oee.Availability
t_Oee_Availability.description: 0 while the line is not running (stopped, E-Stop, reset pending).

t_Sys_HmiHeartbeat.name: Sys.HmiHeartbeat
t_Sys_HmiHeartbeat.label: Sys.HmiHeartbeat
t_Sys_HmiHeartbeat.description: Written by the Pi bridge every poll. PLC clears HMI_LINK_OK if it stops changing (alarm only — never a safety function).

t_Sys_PhysicalEStopMask.name: Sys.PhysicalEStopMask
t_Sys_PhysicalEStopMask.label: Sys.PhysicalEStopMask
t_Sys_PhysicalEStopMask.description: bit i = physical E-Stop button i pressed, from the safety relay's monitoring contacts (bit0 line start, bit1 line end — config.safety.eStopButtons).

t_Counts_LaneA.name: Counts.LaneA
t_Counts_LaneA.label: Counts.LaneA
t_Counts_LaneA.description: Accepted containers sorted to lane A (config.sort.lanes[0]) (wraps).

t_Counts_LaneB.name: Counts.LaneB
t_Counts_LaneB.label: Counts.LaneB
t_Counts_LaneB.description: Accepted containers sorted to lane B (config.sort.lanes[1]) (wraps).

t_Sys_FaultCode.name: Sys.FaultCode
t_Sys_FaultCode.label: Sys.FaultCode
t_Sys_FaultCode.description: First latched station fault, 0 = none: 1 labeler, 2 scanner, 3 arm servo, 4 arm could not pick a lid, 5 arm dropped the lid, 6 sort sensor, 7 scanner node offline, 8 station node offline. Cleared by RESET once the cause is gone.

t_Tank1_LevelMl.name: Tank1.LevelMl
t_Tank1_LevelMl.label: Tank1.LevelMl
t_Tank1_LevelMl.description: Measured level (from field node or analog input).

t_Tank1_Flags.name: Tank1.Flags
t_Tank1_Flags.label: Tank1.Flags
t_Tank1_Flags.description: bit0 ENABLED, bit1 REFILLING, bit2 LOW.

t_Tank1_DispenseRate.name: Tank1.DispenseRate
t_Tank1_DispenseRate.label: Tank1.DispenseRate
t_Tank1_DispenseRate.description: Calibrated flow through the valve at ValveOpeningPct.

t_Tank1_ValveOpeningPct.name: Tank1.ValveOpeningPct
t_Tank1_ValveOpeningPct.label: Tank1.ValveOpeningPct
t_Tank1_ValveOpeningPct.description: Proportional valve opening while dispensing (drives AO_Valve_T<k>_Angle).

t_Container1_Status.name: Container1.Status
t_Container1_Status.label: Container1.Status
t_Container1_Status.description: 0 none, 1 scan, 2 scan-rejected, 3 label, 11..18 fill at bay n (10+n), 20 mix, 21 sort sensor / reject diverter, 22 accepted to lane A, 23 rejected, 24 capping arm, 26 sort diverter, 27 accepted to lane B (25 reserved).

t_Events_LastSeq.name: Events.LastSeq
t_Events_LastSeq.label: Events.LastSeq
t_Events_LastSeq.description: Sequence number of the newest event (wraps; 0 = none).

t_Event1_Seq.name: Event1.Seq
t_Event1_Seq.label: Event1.Seq
t_Event1_Seq.description: Entries are newest first; Event1 is the newest.

t_Scan_Request.name: Scan.Request
t_Scan_Request.label: Scan.Request
t_Scan_Request.description: Container id held at SCAN waiting for a read, 0 = none. A new non-zero value tells the scanner node to trigger one read.

t_Scan_Done.name: Scan.Done
t_Scan_Done.label: Scan.Done
t_Scan_Done.description: Scanner node writes the container id after Status, Length and Text (always last). The PLC acts when Done = Request.

t_Scan_Status.name: Scan.Status
t_Scan_Status.label: Scan.Status
t_Scan_Status.description: 0 OK, 1 NO_READ (nothing within the read timeout), 2 TOO_LONG (text truncated).

t_Scan_ParseResult.name: Scan.ParseResult
t_Scan_ParseResult.label: Scan.ParseResult
t_Scan_ParseResult.description: PLC's validation of the text: 0 OK, 1 BAD_HEADER, 2 BAD_TOTAL, 3 TANK_COUNT_MISMATCH, 4 NEGATIVE_VOLUME, 5 VOLUME_SUM_MISMATCH, 6 MALFORMED, 7 NO_READ. Non-zero → the container rides through unfilled and the reject diverter rejects it.

t_Scan_ResultId.name: Scan.ResultId
t_Scan_ResultId.label: Scan.ResultId
t_Scan_ResultId.description: Container id that Scan.ParseResult and Scan.TotalMl belong to.

t_Scan_TotalMl.name: Scan.TotalMl
t_Scan_TotalMl.label: Scan.TotalMl
t_Scan_TotalMl.description: Recipe total the PLC decoded (0 when rejected).

t_Field_Tank1LevelMl.name: Field.Tank1LevelMl
t_Field_Tank1LevelMl.label: Field.Tank1LevelMl
t_Field_Tank1LevelMl.description: Written by the ESP32 tank-level node; PLC validates range and heartbeat before using it.

t_Field_ScannerNodeHeartbeat.name: Field.ScannerNodeHeartbeat
t_Field_ScannerNodeHeartbeat.label: Field.ScannerNodeHeartbeat
t_Field_ScannerNodeHeartbeat.description: ESP32 scanner node (labeling + barcode scanner) increments ≥ 1 Hz.

t_Field_StationNodeHeartbeat.name: Field.StationNodeHeartbeat
t_Field_StationNodeHeartbeat.label: Field.StationNodeHeartbeat
t_Field_StationNodeHeartbeat.description: ESP32 station node (robotic arm + sort sensor) increments ≥ 1 Hz.

t_Station_RunPermit.name: Station.RunPermit
t_Station_RunPermit.label: Station.RunPermit
t_Station_RunPermit.description: 1 = line running with the safety circuit closed. ESP32 nodes must stop their actuators when 0 or when Sys.PlcHeartbeat stops changing for 1 s. Not a safety function: actuator power still goes through the safety relay.

t_Station_LabelRequest.name: Station.LabelRequest
t_Station_LabelRequest.label: Station.LabelRequest
t_Station_LabelRequest.description: Container id held at LABEL waiting for its label, 0 = none.

t_Station_LabelDone.name: Station.LabelDone
t_Station_LabelDone.label: Station.LabelDone
t_Station_LabelDone.description: Scanner node writes the container id once the label is applied.

t_Station_ArmCmd.name: Station.ArmCmd
t_Station_ArmCmd.label: Station.ArmCmd
t_Station_ArmCmd.description: Robotic arm command: 0 none, 1 HOME, 2 PICK_LID (lift the top lid from the magazine), 3 PLACE_LID (place the held lid on the container at CAP, release, return HOME). The lid-press cylinder seats the lid. Written before ArmCmdSeq.

t_Station_ArmCmdSeq.name: Station.ArmCmdSeq
t_Station_ArmCmdSeq.label: Station.ArmCmdSeq
t_Station_ArmCmdSeq.description: PLC increments (1..65535, skips 0) to issue ArmCmd. The station node runs each sequence number once.

t_Station_ArmDoneSeq.name: Station.ArmDoneSeq
t_Station_ArmDoneSeq.label: Station.ArmDoneSeq
t_Station_ArmDoneSeq.description: Station node copies ArmCmdSeq here when the command has finished, after writing ArmResult.

t_Station_ArmResult.name: Station.ArmResult
t_Station_ArmResult.label: Station.ArmResult
t_Station_ArmResult.description: 1 OK, 2 NO_LID (gripper closed on nothing), 3 LID_LOST, 4 SERVO_ERROR, 5 ABORTED (RunPermit dropped mid-move), 6 REFUSED (not homed / unknown command). The PLC decides retries and faults.

t_Station_ArmStatus.name: Station.ArmStatus
t_Station_ArmStatus.label: Station.ArmStatus
t_Station_ArmStatus.description: bit0 HOMED, bit1 BUSY, bit2 LID_HELD. Kept current by the station node.

t_Station_SortRequest.name: Station.SortRequest
t_Station_SortRequest.label: Station.SortRequest
t_Station_SortRequest.description: Container id at the sort sensor (QC) waiting for a height reading, 0 = none.

t_Station_SortDone.name: Station.SortDone
t_Station_SortDone.label: Station.SortDone
t_Station_SortDone.description: Station node writes the container id after SortHeightMm.

t_Station_SortHeightMm.name: Station.SortHeightMm
t_Station_SortHeightMm.label: Station.SortHeightMm
t_Station_SortHeightMm.description: Measured bottle height, 0 = no valid reading. The PLC classifies the bottle type (config.sort) and rejects a mismatch with the recipe (BOTTLE_TYPE_MISMATCH).

t_Station_ScannerNodeFaults.name: Station.ScannerNodeFaults
t_Station_ScannerNodeFaults.label: Station.ScannerNodeFaults
t_Station_ScannerNodeFaults.description: Written only by the scanner node: bit0 labeler, bit1 scanner module not answering. Any bit → the PLC latches a fault and stops the line.

t_Station_StationNodeFaults.name: Station.StationNodeFaults
t_Station_StationNodeFaults.label: Station.StationNodeFaults
t_Station_StationNodeFaults.description: Written only by the station node: bit0 arm servo bus, bit1 sort sensor. Same handling.

t_Sim_PhysicalEStopMask.name: Sim.PhysicalEStopMask
t_Sim_PhysicalEStopMask.label: Sim.PhysicalEStopMask
t_Sim_PhysicalEStopMask.description: SIMULATION ONLY: drives the physical E-Stop inputs. Ignored unless LineState.SIMULATION = 1. A physical PLC must never act on it with real outputs powered.

t_Sim_LocalMode.name: Sim.LocalMode
t_Sim_LocalMode.label: Sim.LocalMode
t_Sim_LocalMode.description: SIMULATION ONLY: Local/Remote key switch (1 = LOCAL).

t_Cmd_DigitalEStop.name: Cmd.DigitalEStop
t_Cmd_DigitalEStop.label: Cmd.DigitalEStop
t_Cmd_DigitalEStop.description: Digital E-Stop. PLC latches DIGITAL_ESTOP and de-energizes O_Safety_RemoteEStopOK, which opens the hardwired safety circuit. Always accepted, any mode.

t_Cmd_ReleaseEStop.name: Cmd.ReleaseEStop
t_Cmd_ReleaseEStop.label: Cmd.ReleaseEStop
t_Cmd_ReleaseEStop.description: Release the digital E-Stop latch. Does not reset or start the line.

t_Cmd_Jog.name: Cmd.Jog
t_Cmd_Jog.label: Cmd.Jog
t_Cmd_Jog.description: Jog the belt one step. Remote mode, line stopped, safety circuit reset.

t_Cmd_FirePusher.name: Cmd.FirePusher
t_Cmd_FirePusher.label: Cmd.FirePusher
t_Cmd_FirePusher.description: Fire the reject diverter on the container at the sort sensor or reject diverter. Remote mode, no E-Stop.

t_Cmd_Start.name: Cmd.Start
t_Cmd_Start.label: Cmd.Start
t_Cmd_Start.description: Start the line. Remote mode, safety circuit reset, no E-Stop.

t_Cmd_Stop.name: Cmd.Stop
t_Cmd_Stop.label: Cmd.Stop
t_Cmd_Stop.description: Controlled stop. Always accepted, any mode.

t_Cmd_Reset.name: Cmd.Reset
t_Cmd_Reset.label: Cmd.Reset
t_Cmd_Reset.description: Safety reset from the HMI. Only if REMOTE_RESET_ALLOWED, Remote mode, and no E-Stop active; otherwise refused (event COMMAND_REFUSED).

t_Sim_LocalStart.name: Sim.LocalStart
t_Sim_LocalStart.label: Sim.LocalStart
t_Sim_LocalStart.description: SIMULATION ONLY: local panel START push-button.

t_Sim_LocalStop.name: Sim.LocalStop
t_Sim_LocalStop.label: Sim.LocalStop
t_Sim_LocalStop.description: SIMULATION ONLY: local panel STOP push-button.

t_Sim_LocalReset.name: Sim.LocalReset
t_Sim_LocalReset.label: Sim.LocalReset
t_Sim_LocalReset.description: SIMULATION ONLY: local panel RESET push-button.

t_Sim_LocalJog.name: Sim.LocalJog
t_Sim_LocalJog.label: Sim.LocalJog
t_Sim_LocalJog.description: SIMULATION ONLY: local panel JOG push-button.
